entries.gloss_en: in you; with you; against you (prep. بِ + 2 m.s. pronoun)
entries.notes: Fused preposition-pronoun; lemma בִּ (بِ) is s.v. Lane art. bA (prepositions).
entries._grounding: lane s.v. bA (bi-); pronoun suffix -ka standard Arabic; context: בלעם 22:28 מא צנעת בך

entries.gloss_en: in me; with me; against me (prep. بِ + 1 s. pronoun)
entries.notes: Fused preposition-pronoun; same lemma as בך with different suffix.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. bA (bi-); context: לא יומנון בי 14:11

entries.gloss_en: exclusive sacred things; special reserves; sancta
entries.notes: Plural of خاصّة; Lane s.v. خصص: 'he singled it out to the exclusion of others.' In the Tafsir always followed by אלאקדאס (the holy things), translating קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים.
entries._grounding: lisan s.v. خصص: خصّه بالشيء ... أفرده به دون غيره; lane s.v. xSS

entries.gloss_en: other than; not; except
entries.notes: Indeclinable particle of exception; functions as negative adjective or preposition.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. gyr: particle denoting 'other than, not, except'

entries.gloss_en: Lot, son of Haran, nephew of Abraham
entries.notes: Biblical figure; Hebrew לוֹט. Lane s.v. lwT notes lūṭ as a proper name.
entries._grounding: proper noun; biblical equiv. Hebrew לוֹט; context: bereshit 11:27 אולד לוט

entries.gloss_en: between me (prep. بَيْن + 1 s. pronoun suffix)
entries.notes: Fused preposition-pronoun; always in the phrase ביני ובינך/ובינכם.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. byn: bayn = 'between'; context: יחכם אללה ביני ובינך 16:5

entries.gloss_en: her year; its (f.) year (as measure of animal age)
entries.notes: Genitive of سَنَة 'year' + 3 f.s. possessive; used of female sacrificial animals: רכ'לה אבנה' סנתהא = 'a ewe-lamb in its [first] year.'
entries._grounding: lane s.v. snh: sanah/sanah = 'a year'; context: bamidbar 6:14

entries.gloss_en: your fathers; your ancestors (2 m.s.)
entries.notes: Plural آباء of أب 'father' + 2 m.s. suffix; Lane s.v. Abw lists pl. آباء as the preferred form.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. Abw: pl. A=baA='N (آباء) 'fathers, ancestors'

entries.gloss_en: and he washes; bathes (his body)
entries.notes: wa- (و) + imperfect of رَحَضَ 'to wash (a garment or body)'; Lane s.v. rHD. JA apostrophe on ץ' marks ض (ḍād).
entries._grounding: lane s.v. rHD: raḥaḍa 'He washed … a garment … and his hand'

entries.gloss_en: Bashan, region east of the Jordan ruled by Og
entries.notes: Arabic rendering of biblical הַבָּשָׁן; Lane does not lemmatize as geographical; context always 'Og king of Bashan.' JA apostrophe on ת' marks ث.
entries._grounding: proper noun; biblical equiv. הַבָּשָׁן; context: bamidbar 21:33 עוג מלך אלבת'נייה

entries.gloss_en: so it intensified; became fierce or severe
entries.notes: fa- (ف) + form VIII اشتدّ of شدّ 'to be hard/intense'; Lisan s.v. شدد: فاشتدّ 'became intense, strong.' Lane lists the root under $d.
entries._grounding: lisan s.v. شدد: شَدَّه ... فاشتدّ; context: פאשתד ג'צב אללה גדא 11:10

entries.gloss_en: Rebekah, wife of Isaac, daughter of Bethuel
entries.notes: Biblical proper name; Hebrew רִבְקָה; Lane does not have an entry for this name.
entries._grounding: proper noun; biblical equiv. Hebrew רִבְקָה; context: bereshit 22:23 ובתואל אולד רבקה

entries.gloss_en: incense; aromatic fumigant burned as an offering
entries.notes: Lane s.v. bxr: baxūr 'a substance burned for fumigation'; accusative ending -an in JA. JA apostrophe marks خ (kh).
entries._grounding: lane s.v. bxr: baxūr = substance used for fumigation/incense

entries.gloss_en: Heshbon, capital city of Sihon king of the Amorites
entries.notes: Biblical city name; Arabic transcription of Hebrew חֶשְׁבּוֹן; not in Lane as a geographical entry.
entries._grounding: proper noun; biblical equiv. Hebrew חֶשְׁבּוֹן; context: bamidbar 21:25

entries.gloss_en: a tenth part; tithe (one-tenth of an ephah as grain measure)
entries.notes: Lane s.v. E$r: Eu$orN 'a tenth, a tenth part, one part of ten parts.' In the Tafsir renders עִשָּׂרוֹן (the grain measure of one-tenth of an ephah).
entries._grounding: lane s.v. E$r: Eu$orN 'A tenth; a tenth part; one part of ten parts'

entries.gloss_en: amen; so be it (response to prayer or oath)
entries.notes: Lane s.v. Amn: A=miynaN 'amen, a word used at the end of a prayer or supplication.' Indeclinable.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. Amn: A=miyna / A^amiyna = amen after supplication

entries.gloss_en: the stranger; the alien; one far from home
entries.notes: Lane s.v. grb: gariyb 'a stranger, or foreigner; one who is far, or distant, from his home or native country.' Translates Hebrew גֵּר (sojourner).
entries._grounding: lane s.v. grb: gurubah/ghurbah 'the being far or distant from home'; gariyb = stranger

entries.gloss_en: for the sin-offering; as a purification sacrifice
entries.notes: Saadia uses زكوة/דכוה (classical: purity, alms) to render Hebrew חַטָּאת 'sin-offering'; attested in the Arabic transcript of Tafsir Num 6:14 لِلزَّكْوَةِ. Lane s.v. zkw gives 'purity' as a primary sense. This specific sacrificial application is Saadia's technical usage.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. zkw: zakaA = 'purity'; blau s.v. זכו: to gain/acquire. Arabic transcript Num 6:14 confirms לאלדכוה = لِلزَّكْوَةِ = לחטאת

entries.gloss_en: the open country; desert field; uncultivated plain
entries.notes: Lisan s.v. صحر: الصَّحْراء البَرِّيَّة 'the wilderness, the open country'; the trailing yā' in JA אלצחרי is the nisba or pausal yā'. Translates שָׂדֶה/הַשָּׂדֶה.
entries._grounding: lisan s.v. صحر: الصَّحْراء = open field, wilderness, uncultivated country

entries.gloss_en: yesterday; recently
entries.notes: Lane s.v. Ams: 'Yesterday, or the day before the present day'; indeclinable adverb.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. Ams: A^amos = 'yesterday, or the day before the present day'

entries.gloss_en: at that time; thereupon; then
entries.notes: Compound حِين (time/when) + إذٍ (then); Lane s.v. Hyn: HIyn 'a time, a period of time.' The compound حينئذٍ means 'at that time.' JA spelling חיניד' drops the hamza.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. Hyn: HIyn = 'a time'; compound HiynayidhN = 'at that time'

entries.gloss_en: filled (with); full of
entries.notes: Passive participle (m. acc.) of مَلَأَ 'to fill'; Lane s.v. mlA^: malaA^a 'He filled a vessel'; mamlū' = filled. ממלוון is the dual m. form of the same word.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. mlA^: malaA^a 'He filled'; passive part. mamlū' = 'filled'

entries.gloss_en: large bowl; deep dish for offerings
entries.notes: Lane s.v. qSE: qaSoEap 'A bowl not so large as a jafnah … a wooden bowl.' In the Tafsir translates Hebrew קְעָרָה (the offering bowl) weighing 130 shekels.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. qSE: qaSoEah = 'A bowl … that satisfies ten; it is a wooden bowl'

entries.gloss_en: I swore; I took an oath; I vowed
entries.notes: Form IV perfect 1 s. of قَسَمَ; Lane s.v. qsm: A^aqosama Ealayohi 'He conjured him; he said biHaq~ika.' Saadia uses it for divine oath: אקסמת לאברהים ויצחק ויעקוב.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. qsm: A^aqosama 'He conjured; swore by'

entries.gloss_en: Horeb, the mountain of God (Sinai)
entries.notes: Arabic transcription of Hebrew חֹרֵב; Lane s.v. xrb treats خَرِب as 'ruined/desolate' but does not identify this as the place-name. Saadia uses חריב throughout Devarim for the mountain.
entries._grounding: proper noun; biblical equiv. Hebrew חֹרֵב; context: devarim 1:2 מן חריב

entries.gloss_en: Kohath, son of Levi, ancestor of the Kohathite clan
entries.notes: Biblical proper name; Hebrew קְהָת; Lane has no entry. The JA form is a direct transliteration.
entries._grounding: proper noun; biblical equiv. Hebrew קְהָת; context: bamidbar 3:17

entries.gloss_en: their father
entries.notes: أب 'father' (oblique أبي) + 3 m. pl. suffix; Lane s.v. Abw. Same root as אבאיך.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. Abw: ab 'father'; pl. suffix forms discussed

entries.gloss_en: hides; skins (of animals, used for coverings)
entries.notes: Plural of جِلْد 'skin, hide'; Lane s.v. jld: jilodN 'The skin of any animal; the integument of the body.' In the Tafsir: ג'שא גלוד דארש = 'a covering of dugong hide.'
entries._grounding: lane s.v. jld: jilodN 'The skin of any animal … pl. juluwd'

entries.gloss_en: he becomes; it turns into
entries.notes: Imperfect 3 m.s. of صَارَ; Lane s.v. Syr: SaAra 'He, or it, attained to the state or condition of such a thing; became such a thing.' Copular verb like كان.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. Syr: SaAra = 'He attained to the state of; became'

entries.gloss_en: Goshen, the region in Egypt settled by Jacob's family
entries.notes: Saadia's Arabic rendering of Hebrew גֹּשֶׁן (Goshen); Lane does not identify this as a place-name entry. The Arabic السَّدِير appears in Saadia consistently for Goshen.
entries._grounding: proper noun; biblical equiv. Hebrew גֹּשֶׁן; context: bereshit 45:10 בלד אלסדיר

entries.gloss_en: and he looked; and he gazed
entries.notes: fa- (ف) + perfect 3 m.s. of نَظَرَ; Lane s.v. nZr: naZara A_ilayohi 'He looked at, or towards, in order to see.' JA apostrophe on צ' marks ظ (ẓāʾ).
entries._grounding: lane s.v. nZr: naZara = 'He looked at or towards'

entries.gloss_en: he saw; he perceived; he observed
entries.notes: Perfect 3 m.s. of رَأَى 'to see'; the final alif in JA spelling marks the radical ى. Lane s.v. rAY.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. rAY: raA^aY 'He saw it'

entries.gloss_en: the giants; the mighty tyrants; the Anakim
entries.notes: Plural of جَبَّار; Lane s.v. jbr: jabbār 'Huge, tall, and strong; a giant' (tropical sense). Translates Hebrew עֲנָקִים (sons of Anak).
entries._grounding: lane s.v. jbr: jab~aArN 'Huge, tall, and strong; a giant'

entries.gloss_en: is found; there is; let there be found
entries.notes: Imperfect passive 3 m.s. of وَجَدَ (form IV passive يُوجَد or form I passive يُوجَد); Lane s.v. wjd: wajadahu 'He found it.'
entries._grounding: lane s.v. wjd: wajadahu 'He found'; passive yūjad = 'is found'

entries.gloss_en: the great one; the elder; the high priest
entries.notes: Lane s.v. kbr: kabura 'He was or became great.' In the Tafsir האמאם אלכביר = the High Priest (כֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל). Also used for the Great Sea (Mediterranean).
entries._grounding: lane s.v. kbr: kabura 'was or became great'; kabīr = great, big, senior

entries.gloss_en: your dwellings; your settlements
entries.notes: Plural of مَسْكَن 'dwelling, place of abode' + 2 m. pl. suffix; Lane s.v. skn: sakana 'It was, or became, still … and said of a man [dwelling/residing].'
entries._grounding: lane s.v. skn: maskan = 'dwelling, place of abode'

entries.gloss_en: the Sabbath; Saturday
entries.notes: Lane s.v. sbt: sabata 'He rested, and ceased or abstained from works'; AlsabtN 'the Sabbath; and Saturday.' Standard JA term.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. sbt: sabata = 'he rested'; AlsabtN = 'the Jewish Sabbath'

entries.gloss_en: unleavened bread; dough not allowed to rise
entries.notes: Lane s.v. fTr: faTiyrN 'Dough unleavened; or not left until it has become good; contr. of xamiyroN.' Also: Eiydu AlofaTiyri = Feast of Unleavened Bread (Passover).
entries._grounding: lane s.v. fTr: faTiyroN = 'dough unleavened'; contrasts with xamiyroN (leavened)

entries.gloss_en: come! (imperative m.s.); come hither
entries.notes: Imperative 2 m.s. of form VI of عَلَا; Lane s.v. Elw: 'Addressing a man … taEaAla, with fet-h to the l, originally meaning Be thou elevated … used in the sense of Come.' Frozen form regardless of gender/number in spoken usage.
entries._grounding: lane s.v. Elw: taEaAla = imperative 'come!' originally 'be elevated'
